title: The roadmap-one-writer refusal tells the session to fetch before it asks the owner to push
why: A local triage session twice asked the owner to push a commit he had already pushed: its copy of the roadmap branch was stale, and the guard refuses before git reaches GitHub, so the refusal could not say the commit was already there (owner's ask ask-mw79vy66rf, 21:28 CST Nov 7).
note: Fix: the refusal's remedy says to run `git fetch origin roadmap` and to ask the owner only when the commit is not on origin/roadmap. Remedy text only; the hook adds no network call. The debt local-triage-tier-proof removes the situation once local triage can push. Filed 21:30 CST Nov 7. Lane session_013NEJL4KjioFCNuafMd8V8Q started (coordinator, received 21:39 CST Nov 7). Nov 7 22:47 CST: #1777 handed to runner 8. Note from the lane: test RECORD_CARRIES pins neither "exit 0" nor "the commit the push would send". A note, not a debt. Runner 8 (06:16 CST Nov 8): #1777 is in no batch. `merge --reviewed` lists it under "no record:", and runner 8 has no hand-off logged. To join batch 65, the lane posts the tool-printed record for head 26869a9fc (`merge 1777 --review-record --head ...`), runs `merge --lane-lint 1777`, and hands it to runner 8 again. #1777 is ready for batch 65: record posted (issuecomment-6721434823), lane lint PASS at 26869a9fc against main e2703c611, handed to runner 8 again (lane, 06:32 CST Nov 8). Cause: the 22:47 CST hand-off went without the review record. Back to ready 07:22 CST Nov 12 (coordinator yes 07:21 CST): no live lane (was session_013NEJL4KjioFCNuafMd8V8Q).
